title: Equity Incentive Plan

origin.title: Alcoa Corporation Stock and Incentive Compensation Plan (as Amended and Restated) May 6, 2026
origin.clearance_note: The company's own plan document, published for stockholders and participants on Alcoa's equity-plan page (https://www.alcoa.com/equity-plan/). Downloaded directly by script. It contains no personal data and no signatures; the PDF metadata carries only Word's placeholder author.

notes: Features the share pool and award limits on page 5 (Section 4(a), with the director cap from the end of Section 3 just above it): how many shares the plan reserves, the separate cap on incentive stock options, how many shares each full-value award consumes under the current ratio and from when, and the annual cap on director awards. These are the numbers a proxy adviser or compensation analyst reads a plan for, and they sit in one paragraph of running legal prose rather than a table. The request suggested page 5 with the reserve, ISO limit, full-value counting ratio and director cap; all four resolve as ok on page 5 and shipped, with the ratio's effective date added as a fifth. The incentive stock option limit is pinned to occurrence 1, the line reading 'shall not exceed 38,000,000'; occurrence 0 boxes the previous line, which does not contain the number. The ratio's effective date is pinned to occurrence 1, the line reading 'May 6, 2026 and thereafter'.
